metadata.title: Quirky Mixed-Media Collage with Hand-Drawn Doodles

retrievalProfile.description: A surreal mixed-media composition featuring isolated photographic subjects interacting with crude pencil sketches on a background of blue sky and green fields.
excludeWhen: a clean corporate look is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A central photographic figure in awkward attire stands on a white path, surrounded by smaller photographic characters and crude, hand-drawn pencil sketches of animals and faces. The entire scene is anchored by a torn piece of lined notebook paper at the bottom containing hand-written text, with a human hand holding a pencil visible in the lower right corner as if drawing the scene.
coreVisualRelationships: Photographic subjects layered over flat, illustrated backgrounds
Crude pencil sketches interacting with realistic human figures
Torn paper scrap acting as a primary typographic container
Meta-narrative established by a hand drawing the composition
coreInvariants: The presence of a human hand holding a pencil in the foreground
A central full-body photographic subject with a stiff posture
Rough, unrefined pencil sketches of animals or people
A background consisting of simple, flat color blocks for sky and grass

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A tall, thin photographic male figure dominates the vertical center; smaller figures are scattered in the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The torn notebook paper at the bottom center and the large hand in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central figure's face, moves down to the text on the paper scrap, then follows the pencil back up into the doodles.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open blue sky area in the top half provides breathing room for floating sketches.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and grass green provide a bright, flat backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White path and white paper scrap provide high-contrast areas for text and sketches.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Brown and tan tones in the central figure's clothing and the skin tones of the hand.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background colors contrasted with the desaturated, graphite-grey of the pencil sketches.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses fluid, connected cursive with varying line weights
Secondary text uses a clean, geometric sans-serif for legibility
Letters appear as if written with a felt-tip marker or pen
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'D' in the second word has a large, looping ascender
The 'y' has a long, sweeping descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, messy script paired with a functional, small-scale sans-serif for clarity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal, personal feel of the main title.
Provides a clean, modern contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage with a central awkward man in a brown suit, a hand holding a pencil in the bottom right, and crude pencil sketches of a lion and a girl on a pegasus floating in a blue sky over a green field.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a torn piece of lined notebook paper at the bottom with hand-written black script for the title and a small red sans-serif subtitle below it.

verificationChecks: Is the hand holding the pencil visible?
Is the main title on a torn paper scrap?
Are there pencil sketches mixed with photos?
Is the background composed of flat blue and green areas?

adjustableVariables: Posture and attire of the central figure
Angle and size of the foreground hand
Amount of tape used on the paper scrap

mustAchieve: Intentional 'low-fi' or amateurish drawing style for doodles
Clear separation between photo and sketch elements
Tactile feel of the paper and tape
avoid: Clean, straight edges on the paper scrap

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pencil tip aligns with a sketch line
Check that the paper scrap looks physically taped to the scene
Verify the 'doodles' look like graphite on paper
Confirm the central figure has a stiff, awkward silhouette
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [awkward photographic subject] with [crude pencil doodles] on a [flat landscape background], anchored by [hand-written text on a torn paper scrap] and a [foreground hand drawing the scene].
